scope: Read every entry for Burmese sense/naturalness, subtitle utility, GA IPA and explicit forms. No coordinator files modified.
summary: One clear IPA correction (pascal), one useful missing/wrong sense replacement (smacker), several Burmese wording/precision improvements, and one capitalized-headword policy flag. Explicit inflections otherwise look correct; current dictionaries support several initially suspicious IPA variants.

corrections.reason: Current Cambridge US, Merriam-Webster and Collins American entries give final stress and unreduced /æ/ for the pressure unit as well as the namesake. Collins does list /ˈpæskəl/ at lines 317–329, explicitly under 'pascal in British English'; this explains the existing choice but does not support it as GA. Use the contemporary US /pæsˈkæl/.

proposed: အသံမြည်အောင် နမ်းသည့်အနမ်း
ဒေါ်လာတစ်ဒေါ်လာ သို့မဟုတ် ပေါင်တစ်ပေါင်
corrections.reason: The money sense is immediately useful in dialogue about prices ('50 smackers'). The stored second gloss means a strong punch, but the checked current entries principally define loud kiss, mouth/lips, and a dollar/pound; replacing the punch gloss with money is better supported and more useful.

corrections.action: hold or reject unless lowercase canonical spelling is independently established
corrections.reason: Both current Collins and Cambridge display Kafkaesque with capital K. Its meaning and GA IPA are correct, but it is a capitalized eponymous adjective; silently normalizing this to lowercase is questionable under the canonical lowercase/no-proper-name dataset policy. This is a spelling-policy concern, not a claim that the adjective is invalid English.

proposed: ကျွမ်းကျင်သွက်လက်မှု
corrections.reason: The current phrase combines an adverbial စွာ with a nominal ကျွမ်းကျင်မှု awkwardly. The proposed short Burmese noun phrase directly captures skilful dexterity.

proposed: မေးမြန်း၍ အချက်အလက်ရယူခြင်း
corrections.reason: The current မေးမြန်းသိရှိအောင်အချက်အလက်ထုတ်ယူခြင်း is cumbersome and syntactically awkward. This preserves the selected information-gathering sense naturally.

proposed: မလုပ်ရန် နားချတားဆီးခြင်း
corrections.reason: A more direct conversational Burmese rendering; avoids the awkward ဖျောင်းဖျ wording and retains persuasion against action.

proposed: အလုပ်မလုပ်ဘဲ အချိန်ဖြုန်းနေသည်
corrections.reason: ပေကပ်နေသည် can suggest obstinate refusal. The replacement directly conveys idling/dawdling and remains concise.

proposed: လင်နိုလီယမ် အခင်းပြားပေါ် ပုံထွင်း၍ ရိုက်နှိပ်ထားသည့်ပန်းချီ
corrections.reason: The existing generic အခင်းပြား omits the defining linoleum material and could suggest carving a floorboard. Current dictionaries distinguish the linoleum block/design or print; the selected print sense should preserve that distinction.

proposed: ဗလာဖြစ်နေခြင်း
အတွေးအခေါ်အနှစ်သာရ ကင်းမဲ့ခြင်း
corrections.reason: လွတ်ဟာနေခြင်း is unnatural Burmese; ဗလာဖြစ်နေခြင်း is immediately understandable and preserves the emptiness sense.

corrections.action: split the current combined gloss into two concise senses
proposed: ဘာသာရေးယုံကြည်မှု ပြန်လည်တက်ကြွလာအောင် လှုံ့ဆော်ရေး
ဓလေ့ဟောင်းများ ပြန်လည်ရှင်သန်လာစေရန် ကြိုးပမ်းမှု
corrections.reason: The current combined 'ယုံကြည်မှုသို့မဟုတ်ဓလေ့' is broadly right but leaves the principal religious sense unclear. Current Collins distinguishes religious revival activity from restoring older customs/styles.

proposed: အမြင်ဖွံ့ဖြိုးမှု မပြည့်စုံ၍ မျက်စိမြင်အားနည်းခြင်း
corrections.reason: Usually one eye is affected, so the existing gloss describes the common presentation. However, AAPOS explicitly allows one or both eyes; omitting မျက်စိတစ်ဖက် avoids an unnecessary diagnostic restriction while retaining the developmental meaning.

proposed: အမေရိကန်ဘောလုံးတွင် ပြိုင်ဘက်ပို့သည့်ဘောလုံး ကိုယ့်ဂိုးဧရိယာ၌ရပ်သွား၍ အမှတ်မပေးဘဲ သတ်မှတ်နေရာမှ ပြန်စရခြင်း
corrections.reason: Merely saying a ball 'lands in the end zone' also describes a live ball and is too broad. The dictionary sense requires the ball to be downed/dead behind the team's own goal line after the opponent put it there; the short gloss should distinguish that from simply landing.

corrections.action: prefer dropping if stronger subtitle candidates are available; otherwise shorten the carriage gloss
proposedIfKept: တပ် သို့မဟုတ် ခရီးစဉ်အတွက် အသုံးအဆောင်အစုံ
မြင်းလှည်းနှင့် မြင်းကိရိယာအစုံ
corrections.reason: This is genuine but chiefly historical/formal vocabulary. The existing carriage gloss is cumbersome and 'support equipment' is vague. It is a weaker candidate than practical conversational entries, but not automatically invalid or wholly archaic.

acceptedPronunciationReviews.reason: The three-syllable rhotic realization is supported; /ə+r/ and /ɚ/ are transcription alternatives here.
Cambridge explicitly distinguishes US final-root stress from its UK first-syllable variant.
Collins explicitly lists this as an American pronunciation even though Cambridge selects a different US variant.
Collins American entry supports the reduced vowel after /pt/.
The American /neɪtɪv/ ending is supported; do not mechanically replace it with the British /nətɪv/ variant.
Collins American entry explicitly accepts the /oʊ/ variant; Cambridge's /ə/ variant does not invalidate it.
Collins lists the /ndʒ/ American variant beside /nʒ/.

formsReview: All 268 explicit form arrays were inspected. No concrete incorrect spelling or irregular-inflection issue found. In particular, menservants, frontiersmen, groundsmen, plainsmen, quarrymen, triggermen, perihelia, tumuli, pettifogged/pettifogging, lollygagged/lollygagging and shanghaied/shanghaiing are legitimate. Omitted oriented can be correct if it is excluded by prior ownership, so this is not a request to restore a collision.
selectionReview: Most entries have a plausible conversation, crime, period narrative, medical or documentary use. No fabricated compounds or obviously inflected headwords were found by substantive reading. I did not blanket-reject genuine medical or historical vocabulary merely because it is uncommon; equipage is the clearest optional low-value candidate among this set.
